title: "PAC SUJAL FINAL SUBMISSION"
format: html
---

```{r}

# Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(xgboost)
library(caret)

# Load the data
analysis_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/chora/OneDrive/Desktop/PREDICTIVE ANALYSIS/PAC/analysis_data.csv")
scoring_data <- read.csv("C:/Users/chora/OneDrive/Desktop/PREDICTIVE ANALYSIS/PAC/scoring_data.csv")

# Data Preparation
# Replace NA with 0
analysis_data[is.na(analysis_data)] <- 0
scoring_data[is.na(scoring_data)] <- 0

# Preprocess categorical variables
analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))
scoring_data <- scoring_data %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.factor))

# Align factor levels between datasets
for (col in colnames(analysis_data)) {
  if (is.factor(analysis_data[[col]])) {
    scoring_data[[col]] <- factor(scoring_data[[col]], levels = levels(analysis_data[[col]]))
  }
}

# Create dummy-encoded matrices
x <- model.matrix(CTR ~ . - id, data = analysis_data)[, -1]
y <- analysis_data$CTR
scoring_x <- model.matrix(~ . - id, data = scoring_data)[, colnames(x), drop = FALSE]

# Train-Test Split
set.seed(123)
train_index <- createDataPartition(y, p = 0.8, list = FALSE)
x_train <- x[train_index, ]
y_train <- y[train_index]
x_test <- x[-train_index, ]
y_test <- y[-train_index]

# Define XGBoost Parameters
params <- list(
  objective = "reg:squarederror",
  eval_metric = "rmse",
  eta = 0.003,                # Very low learning rate
  max_depth = 4,              # Reduced depth for generalization
  subsample = 0.85,           # Slightly higher subsample ratio
  colsample_bytree = 0.8,
  lambda = 3,                 # Higher L2 regularization
  alpha = 1                   # Higher L1 regularization
)

# Train XGBoost Model with Early Stopping
set.seed(123)
xgb_model <- xgb.train(
  params = params,
  data = xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train),
  nrounds = 8000,             # High number of rounds for gradual updates
  early_stopping_rounds = 100, # Stricter early stopping
  watchlist = list(
    train = xgb.DMatrix(data = x_train, label = y_train),
    eval = xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test, label = y_test)
  ),
  verbose = 1
)

# Predict on Test Data
y_test_pred <- predict(xgb_model, xgb.DMatrix(data = x_test))
rmse <- sqrt(mean((y_test_pred - y_test)^2))
print(paste("Test RMSE:", rmse))

# Predict on Scoring Data if RMSE is Acceptable
scoring_predictions <- predict(xgb_model, xgb.DMatrix(data = scoring_x))
  
# Create Submission File
submission_file <- data.frame(id = scoring_data$id, CTR = scoring_predictions)
write.csv(submission_file, "sample_submissionak.csv", row.names = FALSE)
print("Submission file created: sample_submissionak.csv")

```
